_about: OBEX Dune-oracle results from reference/obex_monthly_pnl.sql, refreshed via Dune MCP on 2026-06-09 (query 7683158, v3). Two methodology fixes vs the original 2026-04-27 capture: (1) the debt sum now UNIONs vat.frob + vat.grab (ALLOCATOR-OBEX-A has duty=0, rate ≡ 1, so the entire stability-fee accrual flows through grab); (2) agent_demand no longer subtracts cum_sub_usds — subproxy USDS is treasury/risk capital drawn from Sky's ilk, so BR accrues on it and the agent rate is paid on a separate ledger flow. Together these align the oracle with the settlement-cycle pipeline's methodology (docs/METHODOLOGY.md §3).
_methodology_notes: Oracle uses prices.day for syrupUSDC valuation (DEX VWAP). Our pipeline uses convertToAssets (canonical NAV) — accounts for the documented ~$220K prime_agent_revenue diff.
Oracle includes vat.grab events alongside vat.frob in the cum_debt sum (refreshed 2026-06-09).

Oracle's agent_demand no longer subtracts cum_sub_usds — matches the pipeline's utilised formula, which keeps subproxy USDS in the BR base (subproxy is treasury/risk capital drawn from Sky's ilk; agent rate is paid as a separate ledger flow rather than netted into the BR base).
Residual ~0.4% diff on sky_revenue is from the oracle's hardcoded SSR step ladder vs the pipeline's live SSR feed around step-change boundaries (e.g., 2026-03-09).
Both pipelines use APY with per-second compounding (POWER((1 + apy), 1/365) - 1).
